assumptions: Units: all rects are PIXELS = Slate units * DPI scale s, rounded to 0.01. s = piecewise-linear curve on min(W,H): 480->0.444, 720->0.666, 1080->1.0, 8640->8.0. Slate viewport = (W/s, H/s) (1280x720 -> 1921.92 x 1081.08 units). Rect = allotted+aligned geometry of the widget (what ArrangeChildren gives it), not the text ink box.

Text metrics: unhinted advance widths from hmtx, no kerning, size in units = style size (the DPI factor cancels because Slate measures at size*scale px and divides back by scale), line height = (hhea.ascender - hhea.descender) * size / unitsPerEm without lineGap. UE hints/rounds advances and rounds ascent/descent to whole pixels: +-1 px per text run (and up to ~1px height) is expected. No text wraps (all strings used are single line at these widths); tooltip text is assumed to be ONE line (empty/one-line height) because the real text depends on the hovered row.

Fonts: NotoSans-Regular/Bold from assets/fonts/Content/UI/Foundation/Fonts/*.ufont (TrueType), Burbank-Black = BurbankBigCondensed-Black.otf (CFF OpenType), Roboto-Bold.ttf read from the pak (Content/Slate/Fonts/Roboto-Bold.ttf).

CommonTextBlock without a Style (tab labels of ButtonStyle-Tab-Manage, which has no NormalTextStyle) uses the UTextBlock default font: Roboto Bold size 24 (ASSUMPTION; matches UE 4.16 UTextBlock constructor).

SizeBox override semantics (UE 4.16 USizeBox bOverride_* flags): in an asset whose SizeBoxes carry any serialized bOverride_* flag (saved by the flag-aware editor) a Width/Height/MinDesired/MaxDesired value counts ONLY when its flag is true; unflagged leftovers are stale and ignored (TabVideoOptions.SizeBox_0: WidthOverride 1400 unflagged, MaxDesiredWidth 1250 flagged => content-sized, clamped to 1250). In a flag-less asset (saved before the flags existed, engine upgrades non-zero values on load: ASSUMPTION) non-zero values are active: HorizontalTabList.SizeBox_231 HeightOverride 88 => the tab strip is 88 high (tab buttons 80 high, centred), top bar 88. The strict-flags and fully-legacy alternatives are computed too and only their differing rects are listed in alternates.*.

SBox with a collapsed child reports zero desired size; Collapsed widgets take no space, Hidden/HitTestInvisible/SelfHitTestInvisible do take space. DisplayResolution keeps its slot (it is only inert/HitTestInvisible).

SBoxPanel: Auto slots get desired+padding, Fill slots share the remainder by weight ignoring their desired size, then AlignChild on both axes (Fill = avail - padding; others = min(desired, avail - padding)). Box desired size sums ALL non-collapsed children including Fill ones (UE SBoxPanel::ComputeDesiredSize).

Border/CommonBorder content padding = BorderSlot.Padding of the child; the Border "Padding" property mirrors it in the decoded data (values are identical where both exist) so it is not added twice. SafeZone has zero insets on PC (pass-through, child slot alignment honoured). BackgroundBlur is a pass-through border slot.

UUserWidget.Padding (instance prop, e.g. [2,2,2,2] on 3DResolution/ViewDistance/Anti-Aliasing/Textures/Effects/PostProcessing, class default [5,5,5,5] on OptionsMenuInput) is applied as padding between the user-widget rect and its root widget, in addition to the parent slot padding. The row.<key> rect is the user widget rect (it includes that padding on the inside).

CommonButton sizing: desired = max(style Min, content desired + ButtonPadding) per axis; content is arranged Fill inside rect minus ButtonPadding. Style used: instance/CDO Style or MouseKeyboardStyle, overridden by whatever SetStyle the owner calls last (HorizontalTabList then OptionsMenu/TabGameOptions OnTabButtonCreated => ButtonStyle-Tab-Manage for the settings tabs, ButtonStyle-Tab-Secondary for the Game/HUD sub tabs). HorizontalTabList.SetMinDimensions(MinTabWidth, 0) runs before the owner SetStyle so the style Min* wins (ASSUMPTION; MinTabWidth default 0).

IconTabButton: LeftSideImage is Collapsed because the tab IconBrush DrawAs is NoDrawType (bytecode); CenterButtonTextWidget is shown (ShowText) with slot padding 4. NormalBangWrapper_C (BangWrapper) is not decoded: treated as a pass-through overlay with zero chrome (ASSUMPTION), so tab width = max(56, textW + 8 + ButtonPadding 40).

IconTextButton: LeftSideImage Collapsed unless IconBrush has a resource; CenterButtonTextWidget Collapsed when the text is empty else SelfHitTestInvisible (SetTextInternal bytecode); RightExtraContentSlot (empty NamedSlot, Fill slot, padding 4) stays Visible at runtime (the only Collapse of it is under IsDesignTime) so it contributes 8 units of width/height; ContentBorder content alignment = ContentAlignment (Fill by default, Center for the Quality-row selector buttons which set ContentAlignment=2). Text style = button style NormalTextStyle.

CommonActionWidget (InputActionWidget, PreviousTabAction, NextTabAction): desired size 0x0 (key icon size unknown); only its slot padding ([2,2,0,0] in IconTextButton) is counted. HorizontalTabList PreviousTabActionWrapper/NextTabActionWrapper are Visible (tab count > 1, bytecode) but contribute 0 width. On a real PC the Q/E key icons / button key icons add width: UNRESOLVED.

TextRotator_C is itself a CommonButton (class default Style ButtonStyle-RotatorBorder: MinWidth 32, MinHeight 32, ButtonPadding [4,4,4,4]); arrow buttons ButtonStyle-Left/Right (Min 18x20, padding [4,4,0,4]) therefore resolve to exactly 18x20 (content 2+8 wide < min). RenderTransform scale(-1,1) of ButtonRight does not change the layout rect.

RotatorSelector/OptionsMenuHudRotator control text: first option of each row from menu-layout-settings.json; native option lists (WindowMode, DisplayResolution, FrameRateLimit, Language, Region) use placeholder strings. Widths never depend on it (rotator min 400 >> text) and heights depend only on the font line height.

OptionsMenuRowSelector buttons are IconTextButton_C with ButtonStyle-Primary-Radio-M (Min 160x48, padding 6 = same geometry as the class-default ButtonStyle-Primary-M), one per option, each slot Fill(1) in SelectorButtonsBox, ContentAlignment Center. Option labels from the row data (Quality has 5 options: low, medium, high, epic, auto).

OptionsMenuSlider: AnalogSlider desired = (16,16) (SSlider default; thumb thickness < 40) so the Overlay height is set by SliderBackground (32x40). UMG Button (class Button, i.e. Button_0 in OptionsMenuSlider/_Light; not CommonButtons) pads its content by SButton::GetCombinedPadding() = ButtonSlot padding (0) + WidgetStyle.NormalPadding ([4,4,4,4] in the decoded style): Button_0 is 48 high with the bar/slider overlay inset 4 on every side. Track/control = Button_0 rect (400 wide, SizeBox min), row.<key>.bar = SliderBackground rect. Hover highlight does not affect layout.

Audio tab: ChatVolume and Quality rows depend on native ShowChatVolume()/ShowQuality(); assumed true on PC (both visible). Game tab: rows other than SafeZone/First-PersonCamera/ShowHeadAccessories/ShowBackpack are Visible (per task statement), including ControllerLookSensitivityX/Y whose labels are set from a PS4/Xbox select (empty label text used).

Tooltip (TooltipDisplay): reported as the widget rect of the tab TooltipDisplay (Fill slot minus its padding); its height is one text line (VAlign_Top tabs) or the full slot height (TabGameOptions: no VAlign => Fill). Real tooltips wrap (AutoWrapText) and are taller.

CommonWidgetSwitcher/CommonListView: only the active switcher child is laid out. CommonListView (Input tab, row count 0 => desired size 0; HUD tab: 7 items generated) fills its slot; HUD items are stacked from the list top at full list width with their own desired height, ignoring the scroll bar (width of a reserved scroll bar, if any, is not subtracted). Input tab SizeBox_0 min 900/max 1200 => 900 wide with an empty list.

Footer: buttons are IconTextButton_C (MouseKeyboardStyle ButtonStyle-BottomBar: Min 160x32, padding [4,0,4,4], text TextStyle-Button-BottomBar-S NotoSans-Regular 18, ContentAlignment Fill so text is left-aligned after the 0-width action widget) added with slot padding [5,0,5,0], V/H Center to a HorizontalBox inside SizeBox(HeightOverride 60 flagged) inside SafeZone (HAlign_Right). Registration order ResetHUDToDefault, ToggleMode, Apply, ResetToDefault, Restore, Back. Shown sets: video/game/hud/brightness/audio=[Restore] (Brightness/Audio/Game inherit the previous tab state, assumed from Video; Game not in zone hides ResetHUDToDefault), input=[ResetToDefault], controller=[ToggleMode, Restore], livestream=[]; Back always last. Apply is not in the initial scenes. BottomBarWidget root Overlay aligned Fill/Bottom over the screen; bottom.bar = Border_7 = [0, H-60, W, 60] in units.

OptionsMenu composition: MainVB Fill(1) = OptionsMenu (rect 0,0,W,H-60 units) + 60 high spacer; OptionsMenu Message overlay is Hidden (takes no part in the layout of siblings). SettingsTabs: HorizontalTabList slot Fill(1)/HAlign_Center/VAlign_Center => rect width = its desired width; the tab strip contains TabButtonBox padding [6,0,6,0] and zero-width Previous/Next action wrappers; ImageHorizRule/ImageGamepadKeyPrompt are Collapsed (ShowRail false, no gamepad).

GamepadMappingInfo (Controller tab): computed generically; Xbox mapping group visible, PS4 group collapsed (ControllerPlatformConfig default "XBox One"), all mapping labels empty (one line high). Only the diagram widget/config/image rects are reported; label texts there are runtime data.

TabAccountLinkage (Live Streaming) only the root (ConfigurationSwitcher) and boxes are reported; FortTwitchLogin_C is not decoded (0 size). Input tab OverlayBorder is measured with the text "PRESS ANY KEY..." (Burbank-Black 48, padding 25); it is Hidden/inert until a key bind is clicked.
Footer visibility of Apply, tab-state changes after interaction, the Message overlay and gamepad prompts are not part of the initial scenes.
unresolved: Key-icon width of CommonActionWidget (bottom-bar buttons, HorizontalTabList Previous/Next tab prompts, IconTextButton InputActionWidget): taken as 0. If the keyboard icon is drawn on PC, every footer button grows by the icon width + 2 and the tab strip by two icon widths.
NormalBangWrapper_C (BangWrapper inside every IconTabButton) is not decoded; zero chrome assumed.
FortTwitchLogin_C inside TabAccountLinkage is not decoded (0 size); only the Live Streaming root is meaningful.

Real text advances (hinted/rounded by FreeType) differ by about +-1 px per text run from the unhinted hmtx widths used here; tab widths, footer button widths for long labels and centred text positions carry that error.
Tooltip text content (and therefore its wrapped height) depends on the hovered row; only one line height is reported.
Exact SizeBox override semantics for flag-less assets (HorizontalTabList.SizeBox_231 HeightOverride 88): see alternates.strictSizeBoxFlags.
Native option lists (WindowMode, DisplayResolution, FrameRateLimit, Language, Region) and key-bind rows (Input tab) are runtime data and not laid out.
Scroll bar width of CommonListView (HUD tab) is not subtracted from item widths.
handChecks: check1 Video tab button width: hand = max(56, 61.324 + 8 + 40) = 109.324  engine = 109.32
check2 WindowMode control: hand x=422.00 w=400 h=32 (min 32, text 21.8+8=29.8)  engine = [422, 115, 400, 32]

strictSizeBoxFlags.description: Same engine, but a SizeBox override value only counts when its bOverride_ flag is serialized true, in EVERY asset (primary result applies that only to flag-aware assets). Differs only through HorizontalTabList.SizeBox_231 HeightOverride 88 (flag-less asset): tab strip/top bar 80 instead of 88, everything below the top bar 8 units higher. Values are the alternate rects of the ids that differ from the primary result.

legacySizeBoxOverrides.description: Same engine, but every serialized non-zero Width/Height/MinDesired/MaxDesired value is active unless its flag is explicitly false (would make TabVideoOptions.SizeBox_0 1400 wide). Values are the alternate rects of the ids that differ from the primary result.
